topic: What beam management strategies are needed to mitigate efficiency fluctuations (>3 dB gain variance) across the 57-66 GHz band?
consensus_response: To mitigate efficiency fluctuations, effective beam management strategies must balance array factor, interference, and spacing effects. Analog beamforming optimization frameworks can adapt to channel conditions, while fully digital beamforming offers better performance but increases complexity. Phase shifter limitations, non-ideal antenna elements, and beam squint effects must be considered.
reference_context: Analog beamforming optimizes receive and transmit problems separately, considering interference mitigation and scheduling granularity in mmWave bands.
